purpose: Route OS-level agent sandboxing, Landlock/seccomp, egress-proxy, and in-container credential isolation here; send host config-write escapes, agent-applied redaction, and generic Dockerfiles elsewhere.

cases.prompt: how do I sandbox my coding agent so it can't read my SSH keys
set up an egress proxy so my agent can't exfiltrate data
keep real API keys out of the agent's container
apply Landlock and seccomp so the agent process cannot open extra files or issue extra syscalls
isolate the agent container with network namespaces and ephemeral per-session mounts
can the agent escape its sandbox by writing a config file that gets executed later
redact sensitive data before sending it across a trust boundary
write a multi-stage Dockerfile with a distroless runtime and image scanning for this API service
